label: NON_FORMAL_DIAGNOSTIC
statement: Cycle Cost was varied on the cleared trajectories Phase 6 produced. Charge, discharge, prices and schedules are held fixed, so these are accounting re-estimations of a frozen policy, not the performance a policy would obtain if the market were cleared again under another cycle cost. Re-clearing would change the dispatch, the nodal prices and the settlement.
cost_function: linear in the rate; confirmed against the stored cycle cost, which equals 100 x throughput on every nonzero row
